notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm making a quick post to let you know that I've uploaded a shiny new build of this game onto Steam! This build fixes a fun and exciting variety of typos which were pointed out by various readers on my Discord sever.

Yay! Thank you very much everybody! \o/

This grimdark little VN should be a little more polished now. As always, do let me know if you find more typos or any bugs in this new build, and I'll try to fix things in a timely manner!

- ebi x

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm writing a quick post to let you know that I've uploaded a new build of All Scars and Starlight. This build fixes a handful of typos which were pointed out to me on my Discord server. Hopefully this should make the project more polished and easier to read.

If you spot more typos in this build (or any bugs) please let me know, and I will try to fix things within a reasonable timeframe.

As always, thank you for your support. It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x
